title: Construction and multi-omics analysis of ccRCC mitochondrial related gene machine learning model and validate of key gene FKBP10.
authors: Pu, Shihang; Qian, Shijie; Xing, Jiajun; Ding, Yiheng; Li, Baochao; Tao, Zhijun; Li, Qi; Yu, Fan; Wang, Zengjun; Xu, Aiming
one_liner_zh: 该研究构建肾透明细胞癌线粒体相关基因的机器学习预后模型并验证FKBP10功能，属于肿瘤预后与免疫微环境分析，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Clear cell renal cell carcinoma represents the most prevalent histological subtype of renal malignancy Emerging evidence underscores the critical involvement of mitochondrial dysfunction in oncogenesis and tumor progression. In this study, we systematically identified and characterized mitochondrial-associated proteins participating in fundamental biological processes, with the objective of elucidating their mechanistic contributions to ccRCC pathogenesis. METHOD: Through integrative analysis of multi-omics data from TCGA-KIRC and GEO datasets, we systematically evaluated the prognostic value of mitochondrial-associated differentially expressed genes derived from the MitoCarta3.0 database. Employing an ensemble machine learning approach encompassing 10 base algorithms and their combinatorial variants, we developed and optimized a robust prognostic risk model. Subsequent experimental validation focused on the core model gene FKBP10, investigating its functional role in ccRCC pathogenesis through comprehensive in vivo analyses. RESULT: We identified 102 mitochondrial-related differentially expressed genes showing significant tumor-normal tissue expression differences and strong prognostic associations. The LASSO+GBM algorithm was selected as the optimal model, from which we derived 7 core prognostic genes. Comprehensive characterization of high- and low-risk groups revealed distinct patterns in pathway activation, mutational profiles, immune microenvironment composition, and therapeutic vulnerabilities. Experimental validation confirmed that the key gene FKBP10 promotes malignant phenotypes in tumor cells through IL-6/JAK/STAT3 pathway activation.
abstract_zh: 背景：透明细胞肾细胞癌是肾恶性肿瘤中最常见的组织学亚型。新近证据强调线粒体功能障碍在肿瘤发生和肿瘤进展中的关键参与。在本研究中，我们系统性地鉴定并表征了参与基本生物学过程的线粒体相关蛋白，旨在阐明它们对ccRCC发病机制的机制贡献。方法：通过对TCGA-KIRC和GEO数据集的多组学数据进行整合分析，我们系统评估了源自MitoCarta3.0数据库的线粒体相关差异表达基因的预后价值。采用包含10种基础算法及其组合变体的集成机器学习方法，我们开发并优化了一个稳健的预后风险模型。后续实验验证聚焦于核心模型基因FKBP10，通过全面的体内分析研究其在ccRCC发病机制中的功能作用。结果：我们鉴定了102个线粒体相关差异表达基因，这些基因在肿瘤与正常组织间表现出显著表达差异，并具有强预后关联性。LASSO+GBM算法被选为最优模型，从中我们获得了7个核心预后基因。对高风险和低风险组的全面表征揭示了通路激活、突变谱、免疫微环境组成和治疗脆弱性方面的不同模式。实验验证确认关键基因FKBP10通过IL-6/JAK/STAT3通路激活促进肿瘤细胞的恶性表型。
